format.description: Fills the layout's `%s` placeholders with the operands, in order.

arguments.name: operands
arguments.description: The values put in the placeholders, in order.

return.description: The layout with each placeholder filled.

merge.description: Merges the contents into the map holding the call, its own keys winning.

arguments.name: contents
arguments.description: The maps merged in, in order.

loop.description: Repeats the body once per item of the collection.

arguments.name: in
arguments.description: The collection, a list or a map.

arguments.name: body
arguments.description: What each pass yields: a map's entries, or a list's one element.

arguments.name: for
arguments.description: The loop variables: one binds each item, two bind each key or index and its value.

locals.description: Named values a document reads as `local.<name>`.

^(\\S+ )?fn\\.[a-z0-9_]+\\*?$.description: A field whose value a function call computes when the document is used, such as `message fn.format*`.

retries.description: Times a failed job is run again.

needs.description: The jobs that finish first, as references.

message.description: What the job announces when it starts.
